The most common reason AI investment proposals get rejected is not that the CFO does not believe in AI.

It is that the proposal is vague.

"Improve efficiency" is not a benefit. "Save time" is not a benefit. These are categories of benefit. A CFO needs to know: how many hours, at what loaded cost, recovered from which specific workflows, measured how.

We published the ROI breakdown this week — department by department, with actual benchmarks and the full calculation framework.

The number that tends to stop people: 514 hours recovered per month across a 5-department mid-market team. At average fully-loaded labor costs, that is $33,850 per month in recovered capacity. Against a $500/month platform cost.

Payback period: 16 days.

The math is not the hard part. Building the business case clearly enough that it gets approved is the hard part. The article covers both.

twitter_thread: Most AI investment proposals get rejected because the benefit is vague. "Save time" is not a benefit. Here is the ROI framework that gets AI productivity tools approved — with real benchmarks by department:

The calculation: (hours recovered per month × fully-loaded labor cost) − (platform cost + maintenance cost) = monthly net value. Monthly net value / implementation cost = payback period. Simple. The hard part is getting the inputs right.

HR benchmarks: 57 hours recovered per month. Interview scheduling (13 hrs), onboarding management (32 hrs), PTO routing (9 hrs), performance review coordination (3 hrs). At $55/hr fully-loaded: $3,135/month. Annual: $37,620.

Finance benchmarks: 88 hours recovered per month. Weekly report (15 hrs), AP processing (39 hrs), month-end close (24 hrs), cash flow forecast (10 hrs). At $70/hr: $6,160/month. Annual: $73,920. Highest ROI per team member of any department.

CS benchmarks: 142 hours recovered per month — highest of any department. Ticket triage (44 hrs), health score updates (60 hrs), onboarding check-ins (8 hrs), renewal prep (30 hrs). At $60/hr: $8,520/month. Annual: $102,240.
Full 6-department total: 514 hours/month, $33,850/month, $406,200/year. Platform cost: $500/month. Implementation: $5,200 one-time. Payback period: 16 days. These are conservative estimates.
